description: This Java class 'PartitionedQueueResponseTemplate' manages request-response messaging using partitioned queues, handling request processing, response sending, and resource management within a messaging system.

classes.name: PartitionedQueueResponseTemplate
classes.description: A template class for handling partitioned queue request-response pattern with request processing, response handling, and resource management.

methods.name: processRequests
methods.description: Processes incoming requests, manages request timeout, and sends responses or error responses.

methods.name: sendErrorResponse
methods.description: Constructs and sends an error response message when request processing fails.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the consumer to specified topic partitions.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the consumer, producer, and scheduler resources gracefully.
